snippet.title: Infinity Sweeper - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://www.yogscast.games/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161400/Infinity_Sweeper/

Minesweeper gone rogue!
Infinity Sweeper is a fresh and exciting twist on the classic Minesweeper concept, blending strategy, rogue-lite mechanics, and endless challenges into one thrilling experience.

Fans of Minesweeper will instantly recognize the grid-based gameplay but will quickly discover a whole new world of danger, rewards, and strategy.
